parameters.name: VendorID
parameters.description: Identifies the vendor of the ONU. See {{bibref|G.988|Section 9.1.1}}.

parameters.name: SerialNumber
parameters.description: Represents the combination of the Vendor-ID and the Vendor-specific serial number (VSSN). The parameter shows the serial number in a human readable format. Example: if the vendor ID is ABCD and the VSSN encodes the number 1234568, the value of this parameter is ABCD12345678. See {{bibref|G.988|Section 9.1.1}}.

parameters.name: ONUID
parameters.description: Identifier that the OLT assigns to this ANI during the activation. See: * {{bibref|G.9807.1|Section C.6.1.5.6}} * {{bibref|G.984.3|Section 5.5.2}} * {{bibref|G.987.3|Section 6.4.2}} * {{bibref|G.989.3|Section 6.1.5.6}}

object.description: This object shows info related to the activation of this ANI by an OLT.
